section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for an online cross-sectional survey, referred to as 'The study', which was approved by a university ethics committee. Data were collected from the Youth Body Image Survey (YBIS) hosted on YouBeauty.com between September and December 2012. Participants provided online informed consent and completed various scales, including the Body Appreciation Scale, with demographic information collected on the penultimate page.
